messages.content: You verify mechanical CAD edits from rendered views.

content.text:
Edit instruction: Set the shank length equal to 2.4 times the head diameter; the head, slot, and shank radius stay the same.

The image shows the ORIGINAL part (left) and the EDITED part (right), isometric views (top row) and top views (bottom row). Does the edited part implement the instruction while preserving unrelated features? Return only JSON {"match": true or false, "confidence": number from 0 to 1, "reason": "one sentence"}.

response:
```json
{
  "match": true,
  "confidence": 0.9,
  "reason": "The edited part shows a significantly elongated shank that appears to be roughly 2.4 times the diameter of the head, while the head diameter, shank width, and slot features remain visually consistent with the original part."
}
```
